question: After fixing task or physical-run marginal mass, how much root-to-leaf linearization distortion remains within those strata, and is that conditional distortion broad rather than concentrated in a few strata?

fixed_population.population_rule: Reuse every eligible endpoint and every same-run observed child-parent edge from the fixed outcome-blind tree-linearization audit; no task, run, edge, or multiplicity subset may be selected after results.

disclosed_pre_freeze_values.interpretation: The two lower bounds follow from TV(p,q) <= TV(p,r_G) + TV(r_G,q), so merely exceeding them is not a new empirical discovery. The pre-registered positive readout is at least 0.05 exact slack above each recomputed bound plus breadth and anti-dominance gates.

estimands.canonical_edge_measure: p(e)=1/E over E distinct observed child-parent edges
estimands.path_frequency_edge_measure: q(e)=m_e/M, where m_e is the descendant-leaf path multiplicity and M=sum_e m_e
estimands.conditional_tv: For group g, c_g=TV(p(e|g),q(e|g))=(1/2) sum_{e in g}|1/E_g-m_e/M_g|.
estimands.primary_canonical_standardized_within_tv: W_p(G)=sum_g (E_g/E)c_g; equivalently TV(p,r_G) where r_G keeps canonical group marginals and path-frequency conditionals.
estimands.secondary_path_standardized_within_tv: W_q(G)=sum_g (M_g/M)c_g; reported as sensitivity and never rescues the primary.
estimands.triangle_slack: S(G)=W_p(G)-max(0,TV(p,q)-B(G)); exact nonnegative slack above the lower bound already implied by disclosed aggregates.
estimands.conditionable_group: A group with at least two observed edges; all such groups stay in the breadth denominator, including groups with c_g=0.
estimands.group_contribution: a_g=(E_g/E)c_g; maximum contribution share is max_g a_g/W_p(G), or zero only when W_p(G)=0.

fixed_distribution_summary.histogram_rule: Left-closed/right-open bins, except the final bin includes 1. Values and counts are anonymous and sorted; no task or run identifiers may be emitted.

classification_rule: Hard-gate failure takes precedence. Otherwise each axis is strong only if its exact triangle slack, breadth fraction, and maximum-contribution-share gates all pass. Both axes strong maps to BROAD; exactly one maps to the matching one-axis class; positive W_p below those gates maps to PROFILE_BELOW_STRONG_GATE; exact zero on both axes maps to NO_OBSERVED. Path-standardized sensitivity cannot rescue any primary gate.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_broad: On this fixed outcome-blind MLE-agent observed forest, path linearization changes edge measures materially within both task and physical-run strata after their marginals are fixed; the exact canonical-standardized shifts exceed the already-implied triangle lower bounds by at least 0.05 and pass predeclared breadth and anti-dominance gates.

failure_rule: Any snapshot, source hash, upstream aggregate, schema, graph, exact arithmetic, support, anonymity, byte-reproducibility, independent-verification, or security mismatch fails closed. No population, threshold, axis, denominator, or classification order may change after within-stratum values are computed.
